messages.subject: Compilation errors
parts:
Hello,

I am new to Nimble and just installed it.  I just worked through the pump example as a way of testing my installation and although it worked, I received the following warnings.  I'm wondering if these are something to be concerned about or can be ignored.

Thank you,
Brian

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Compilation errors
parts:
Thanks for the message, Brian.

Those warnings can be ignored.  There are some compilers that benefit from those C++ compilation flags, and others that give warnings that they don't support those flags!

-Perry
